note: One entry per terrain a biome draws. `art` is the 3x3 block and `corner` the 2x2 piece, drawn as they are with no skirt: a block keeps the rim it was drawn with. The `face` of a biome is its cliff, the ring cliff recoloured and baked over the ground of that biome. `blend` is a ring in the colour of the ground of a biome, drawn over a neighbour where two biomes meet. `deep` names the darker pool a biome mixes into a wide body of water; nothing reads it yet.
